task.title: Install HP LaserJet Driver on Windows 11
task.shortdesc: Steps to download and install the HP LaserJet driver on Windows 11, including a User Account Control (UAC) warning.

prereq.p: Ensure you have administrative privileges on the Windows 11 machine.

step.cmd: Download the latest HP LaserJet driver from the HP support website.
Double-click the downloaded driver file to begin the installation.
step.result: The User Account Control (UAC) prompt appears.

step.cmd: Click Yes to allow the installation to proceed.
Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the installation.
